info.title: Milten API
info.description: JSON API for the Milten personal blogging platform. Authentication is maintained with an HttpOnly JWT cookie named `token`.

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Registration, login, logout, and account management

200.description: Login successful. The response sets the HttpOnly `token` cookie.

204.description: Account deleted and authentication cookie cleared

200.description: Updated profile. The authentication cookie is replaced with a token containing the new profile.
Posts. When `term`, `q`, or `page` is supplied, the response includes pagination.

post.description: Requires an authenticated user with the `admin` role.

put.description: Requires an authenticated user with the `admin` role.

delete.description: Requires an authenticated user with the `admin` role.

get.summary: Get the current user's like status

200.description: Post liked (repeating the request is idempotent)

get.summary: Get the current user's bookmark status

200.description: Post bookmarked (repeating the request is idempotent)

put.description: Only the comment owner can update a comment.

delete.description: The comment owner or an administrator can delete a comment.

200.description: Public profile and the user's comments

get.summary: List posts liked by a user
List posts bookmarked by a user

cookieAuth.name: token
cookieAuth.description: JWT issued by `/api/auth/login` and stored in an HttpOnly cookie.

SetCookie.description: The HttpOnly JWT authentication cookie. The exact attributes depend on the deployment environment.

schema.description: Search title, content, and category. The server truncates longer values to 255 characters.
Alias for `term`. The server truncates longer values to 255 characters.

content.description: Rich-text HTML. It is sanitized by the server before persistence.
Rich-text HTML. It is sanitized by the server before persistence.

Password.description: At least 8 characters, including one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one digit.

author.description: Display name, or `Deleted account` when the author no longer exists.

likes.description: Liked posts when returned by the likes endpoint.

bookmarks.description: Bookmarked posts when returned by the bookmarks endpoint.

PaginatedPostReferences.description: The response contains either `likes` or `bookmarks`, depending on the endpoint.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or credentials are invalid.

InvalidToken.description: The JWT is invalid or expired.

AdminForbidden.description: The authenticated user is not an administrator.

CommentForbidden.description: The authenticated user cannot modify this comment.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with an existing resource.

CommentsNotFound.description: No comments were found for the post.

TooManyRequests.description: Too many authentication requests from this address.

Retry-After.description: Number of seconds until the rate-limit window resets.
